description: This file defines serialization and copying logic for ReadOnlyCollection<T> types in Orleans. It includes a surrogate type for serialization, a serializer class, and a deep copier class, all tailored to handle ReadOnlyCollection<T> instances.

classes.name: ReadOnlyCollectionSurrogate<T>
classes.description: A surrogate type used for serialization of ReadOnlyCollection<T>, containing a list of values.

classes.name: ReadOnlyCollectionCodec<T>
classes.description: A serializer class for ReadOnlyCollection<T> that converts to and from the surrogate type.

classes.name: ReadOnlyCollectionCopier<T>
classes.description: A deep copier class for ReadOnlyCollection<T>, creating deep copies of the collection and its elements.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back to a ReadOnlyCollection<T> instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlyCollection<T> to its surrogate representation.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a ReadOnlyCollection<T> instance, handling cyclic references.
